Outside Law (Kania Law Firm) current and upcoming foreclosure sale date

For questions on these foreclosures, please contact The Kania Law Firm at 828-252-8010 ext. 115 or at taxsales@kanialawfirm.com for more information. The Rutherford County Tax office will not be able to answer foreclosure questions on these properties except for basic questions (ie- acreage, amount of tax owed (DOES NOT INCLUDE FORECLOSURE/ATTORNEY FEES), location, etc.)


PLEASE CONTACT THE RUTHERFORD COUNTY CLERK OF COURT FOR THE MOST UP TO DATE INFORMATION CONCERNING UPSET BID PROCESS, LAST DAY TO BID, AND AMOUNT OF CURRENT BID 1-828-288-6100
**If you are actively bidding on a property, it is YOUR responsibility to keep track if your bid has been upset.  Will not call to update you.**

***HOW TO UPSET THE CURRENT BID: GO TO THE CLERK OF COURT'S OFFICE, CIVIL DIVISION, AND GIVE THEM THE FILE NUMBER OF THE PROPERTY IN WHICH YOU WOULD LIKE TO UPSET THE BID. THEY ONLY ACCEPT CASH OR CERTIFIED FUNDS; NO PERSONAL CHECKS.***

Other County surplus properties and equipment may be available. 
Please check our GovDeals page for more information.  

         Please read the information provided on the Foreclosure Process link for further information: Foreclosure Process

Mortgage Style Foreclosures are handled by Kania Law Firm and can be reached by calling 828-252-8010 ext. 115 or email them at: taxsales@kanialawfirm.com

To see the properties Kania has in foreclosure in Rutherford and surrounding counties, visit this link to their foreclosure webpage:  https://kanialawfirm.com/tax-foreclosures/foreclosure-listings/     

       Current foreclosures that are in the upset bid period, please contact Kania Law at 828-252-8010 ext. 115 or at taxsales@kanialawfirm.com for more information. The Rutherford County Tax office will not be able to answer foreclosure questions on these properties except for basic questions (ie- acreage, amount of tax owed (DOES NOT INCLUDE FORECLOSURE/ATTORNEY FEES), location, etc.)
